lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: The village below reads as a Commons holding in every register I am able to reach, of which there are four. That is unusual. I would like it to remain unusual and I am aware that is not a thing I can act on.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: The village below is listed as a Meridian trust, inherited three times, never contested. The inheritance is clean. I have checked it twice because I wanted it to be otherwise, which I record as an error in method.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: I would not raise it with Sister Wren.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: Dax has not spoken to me in two days. I want to be accurate: he is not being cruel. He is being consistent, which is harder to argue with and considerably worse to be near.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: You have been generous to a thing that is owned. I have noticed. I am entering it in the register of the dead, which is the only register I keep, and I am aware that is not where it belongs.

lines.speaker: ilo9
lines.text: I keep the second office, the register of the dead, and now, apparently, a party inventory. Three functions. That is two more than I had in a hundred and sixty years and I find I am content.
